subject: Human Body
title: Leptin and Hunger Signals
description: A short lesson to help you apply Leptin and Hunger Signals.

hook.text: Fat cells aren't just storage. They send hormonal signals to your brain about how much energy you have stored.

buildup.text: Leptin is produced by fat tissue.

discovery.text: Ghrelin is leptin's counterpart. Made by the stomach when empty, it signals hunger. Leptin says 'stop.

twist.text: Obese individuals often have high leptin but their brains become resistant to it.

climax.text: Leptin resistance explains why willpower alone often fails in obesity.

punchline.text: Obesity can make the brain deaf to its own 'stop eating' signal.

quiz.question: Why do obese individuals often still feel hungry?
options: Their brains become resistant to leptin's appetite-suppressing signal
Ghrelin production increases proportionally with body fat
